EasyUse Anima 1.4.0 adds per-LoRA trigger-word controls to Anima LoRA Preset.

Changes:
1. Click T+/T− beside a LoRA, or use its context menu, to include or exclude its trigger words without changing the LoRA's enabled state or model and CLIP strengths.
2. Each profile and saved workflow remembers the trigger-word choice.
3. Existing profiles and workflows keep trigger words enabled by default. Node IDs, output sockets, LoRA stacks and style prompts are unchanged.

Compatibility:
This release provides the preset's own trigger-word toggle. Direct integration with TriggerWord Toggle (LoraManager) is not included.

Action required:
Restart ComfyUI and hard-refresh the browser after updating. T+ includes that LoRA's trigger words; T− excludes them. Save the profile after changing the toggle to reuse the choice.
